sloka: स रामः रथम् आस्थाय सम्प्रह्Rष्ट सुह्Rज् जनः ।पताकाध्वजसंपन्नं महार्हगुरुधूपितम् ॥२-१७-१॥
transliteration: sa rāmaḥ ratham āsthāya samprahRṣṭa suhRj janaḥ ।patākādhvajasaṁpannaṁ mahārhagurudhūpitam ॥2-17-1॥

translations.english: Surrounded by friends overwhelmed with great joy, that glorious Rama aboard the chariot beheld the city decorated with banners and pennants and made fragrant with expensive incense and agaru and crowded with multitudes of people.
translations.hindi: शत्रुहन्ता श्रीरामचन्द्र मरण के समान पीडादायक: केकेयी 'के वचन सुन कर जरा भी दुःखी न हुए और उससे बोले
